answer: Jetty-berth registry: each identity holds one numbered berth at a working jetty, $180/month mooring per berth. A harbor beacon pings the berth's transponder at a random hour; the reply must match that night's nebula of AIS traffic around the jetty, timestamped and signed. A farm's 1,000 fakes need 1,000 berths, $180,000/month, and one shared transponder fails the AIS cross-check and burns all its berths.
